svg.text: Print on its side (the 10 mm face on the bed), 100 % infill.

svg.text: A bridge 10 mm wide: top bar 33 x 8 mm, two legs 4 mm thick and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 14.75 mm tall, 29 mm apart between centres.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3.4 mm hole down through each leg and the bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the bar lies on top of the cell, 46 mm from the cell's spring end;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the legs stand on the two strap bosses beside the cradle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two M3 x 25 low-head screws down through the strap into the inserts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It holds the cell down in a drop: about 550 N at 1.3 times margin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the cell cannot lift and the screw heads are below 31 mm.
